enrichment.title: Growth Designer
enrichment.description: Linear is looking for a senior product designer to own growth surfaces — onboarding, activation flows, and the marketing site — across web and desktop. You will design and ship growth surfaces, partner with growth engineering on experimentation, and own activation as a measurable IC outcome. Must-haves include 5+ years shipping growth or activation work and a portfolio with measurable outcomes. Tools: Figma, React, Statsig.
requirements: 5+ years shipping growth or activation work
